If you're using an iPhone 16 or newer, consider pairing it with a Qi2.2 charger to take full advantage of the 25W MagSafe charging speeds your phone supports. Anker's newly released 25W Prime MagSafe three-in-one charger is a solid option, with an extremely portable design.

First Impressions

The major trend in the second half of 2025 is bringing 25W Qi2.2 to every wireless charging accessory, and this momentum continues into 2026. Anker is leading the industry in this regard—their brand-new portable MagSafe three-in-one charger incorporates 25W Qi2.2 support into an exceptionally lightweight design.

To achieve 25W wireless charging, active cooling is almost essential. Nearly all 25W chargers on the market come equipped with this feature, and Anker's new foldable three-in-one charger is no exception.

The package includes a 45W charger and USB-C cable, more than enough to simultaneously charge your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch. Using this charging stand, you can charge your iPhone 18 Pro to 50% in just 27 minutes.

Remember the MagSafe Duo? If you once loved that product but were disappointed when Apple discontinued it, you might appreciate this new release. It's almost as portable as the MagSafe Duo, but with two major advantages: it can be used as a stand, and it can charge three devices simultaneously instead of two.

This charger has a fairly interesting (though honestly not strictly necessary) function: the Apple Watch charger features a pop-out design. When folded, it tucks away; when you're ready to open it, just give it a light press and it pops out. I think this design is quite clever, and it makes the product's high price tag more justifiable.

Conclusion

Overall, if you're looking for a stylish and portable MagSafe three-in-one charger, Anker's new product is a solid choice. It has built-in active cooling, allowing you to quickly charge your iPhone without overheating or experiencing the other side effects that wireless charging can sometimes bring.

Anker's brand-new three-in-one MagSafe charger is now available on Amazon for $99, with free shipping for Prime members, available in black and white.
